description: Defines the AliasInfo class used for representing aliasing information in the PyTorch ATen library, including alias sets, containment, and serialization operators.

classes.name: AliasInfo
classes.description: Data structure to hold aliasing information for an Argument, supporting nested aliasing info for contained types.

methods.name: AliasInfo(bool is_write, const std::set<std::string>& before_qual_strings, const std::set<std::string>& after_qual_strings)
methods.description: Constructor initializing alias sets from qualification strings.

methods.name: static Symbol wildcardSet()
methods.description: Returns the symbol representing a wildcard alias set.

methods.name: void setIsWrite(bool isWrite)
methods.description: Sets whether the alias info is for a write operation.

methods.name: bool isWrite() const
methods.description: Checks if the alias info is for a write operation.

methods.name: void addBeforeSet(Symbol aliasSet)
methods.description: Adds an alias set to the before sets.

methods.name: void addAfterSet(Symbol aliasSet)
methods.description: Adds an alias set to the after sets.

methods.name: const std::unordered_set<Symbol>& beforeSets() const
methods.description: Returns the set of alias sets before execution.

methods.name: const std::unordered_set<Symbol>& afterSets() const
methods.description: Returns the set of alias sets after execution.

methods.name: Symbol beforeSet() const
methods.description: Returns the single before set, asserts size is 1.

methods.name: bool isWildcardBefore() const
methods.description: Checks if the before set is a wildcard.

methods.name: bool isWildcardAfter() const
methods.description: Checks if the after set is a wildcard.

methods.name: void addContainedType(AliasInfo aliasInfo)
methods.description: Adds contained aliasing info for nested types.

methods.name: const std::vector<AliasInfo>& containedTypes() const
methods.description: Returns contained aliasing info for nested types.
